title: Tera
subtitle: Render templates from inline text or named files
intro: Render JSON context with Tera’s variables, filters, loops, and conditionals. Keep short templates in SQL, or load named files for larger templates and inheritance. Results are ordinary text columns ready for export or further processing.

reference.name: tera_render(template)
reference.description: Render inline template text without context.

reference.name: tera_render(template, context)
reference.description: Render with a JSON object supplying variables.

reference.name: autoescape := false
reference.description: Turn off HTML escaping for non-HTML output.

reference.name: template_path := glob
reference.description: Load template files; the first argument becomes a name.

reference.name: {{ value | upper }}
reference.description: Interpolate a value and apply a Tera filter.

reference.name: {% for x in items %}
reference.description: Loop through context items; finish with endfor.

notes.title: Choose inline text or a file
notes.body: Without template_path, the first argument is template source. With a file glob, use a matching template name such as email.html. Files support includes, inheritance, and reusable template authoring outside SQL.

notes.title: Escaping follows the output
notes.body: HTML autoescape is enabled by default. Turn it off for plain text or configuration output, and keep templates trusted. For generated SQL, pass untrusted values through prepared-statement parameters instead of interpolating them.

examples.title: Render HTML from context
examples.caption: HTML escaping applies to the interpolated value.

examples.title: Render a plain-text list
examples.sql:
SELECT tera_render(
  '{% for x in xs %}{{ x }}' ||
  '{% if not loop.last %}, {% endif %}' ||
  '{% endfor %}',
  '{"xs":["B&O","Acme"]}',
  autoescape := false
);
-- B&O, Acme
examples.caption: Use loop.last for separators; disable autoescape for plain text.

examples.title: Use a named template file
examples.caption: Requires ./templates/email.html, for example: Hello {{ name }}!
examples.reason: Requires the template file shown in the caption; the PDF does not create it.

assertions:
SELECT CASE WHEN tera_render('

{{ name | upper }}

', '{"name":"Ada & Grace"}') = '

ADA & GRACE

' AND tera_render('{% for x in xs %}{{ x }}{% if not loop.last %}, {% endif %}{% endfor %}', '{"xs":["B&O","Acme"]}', autoescape := false) = 'B&O, Acme' THEN true ELSE error('Tera result mismatch') END;
